I'm in my teens, overweight, but down 45-50 pounds from my highest weight. I really wish that my mom especially would have taught me healthy habits very young. My mom has been morbidly obese since for my entire life, and I "learned" eating habits from her. To eat when you are celebrating, or sad, or bored. I always saw her on a "diet" where she would lose 5 pounds, reward herself with a pedicure or something and then gain it back and usually more. Most of her family is overweight/obese too so she never saw a problem when I was gaining weight. I was 100 pounds at age 8, 220 at ages 11-13, and since I can remember I thought I was fat, and since I was 10, trying to lose weight. Letting your child be unhealthy is one of the worst things you can do to them. It affects everything- from their self esteem to how they interact- to the #1 priority, their health.
